Author: EvolvedXIV
Name: Job Gauge Evolved
Description:
Draws improved job gauges that you can resize, move and recolour, with a settings section and an on/off switch per job.

Viper: the Vipersight blades and the Serpent Offerings gauge in one. A blade lights up when the game would recommend its button from your Honed and venom buffs, and goes dark when the buffs run out. At the finisher both blades show a flank attack, or a glow around the orb shows a rear attack, and the blade of the finisher your venom empowers is brightest. Lit parts glow with a pulse of energy every 2 seconds, and a lit blade's colour is added to its steel. Also shows the Anguine Tributes and the Reawaken timer, the gauge value and your Rattling Coils.

Open the settings with /jge.
